about: The polish cases of named plugin sets across the verbs (fix-j102-plugin-sets, GAPS S117, 2026-11-15), in the shape of polish.json. In a file of their own so that other fixes' cases don't collide with them.

cases.title: query2 over @official gives the rows of the same 33 plugins named by their names and patterns, and says how the set was named (GAPS S117)
cases.before: (The S116 census over @official is the note's targeted test: it reads 7.7 million Forms rows, too heavy for a polish case.) query2 --plugins @official (and query2 @official "...") answered "@official isn't in Data": a census over the official plugins needed every name listed.

params.sql: SELECT Plugin, count(*) AS Weapons, sum(AttackDamage) AS Damage FROM Weapon GROUP BY Plugin ORDER BY Plugin;
SELECT Plugin, count(*) AS Weapons, sum(AttackDamage) AS Damage FROM Weapon GROUP BY Plugin ORDER BY Plugin;

pass_if.name: the same rows as the names and patterns; the set repeated with its count

cases.title: A wrong set name is a clear error with the near one; @winners where it doesn't apply says what to use (GAPS S117)
cases.before: query2 --plugins @offical said "@offical isn't in Data"; find, refs2 and indexes had no sets at all.

pass_if.name: the errors name the sets; find over @official answers and repeats the set

all.matches: isn't a set of plugins SFSearch knows \(did you mean @official\?\)
@winners counts each record only in the version the game uses.*use @loaded
